focused-components.command:
npx playwright install --with-deps chromium webkit
sudo apt-get update
sudo apt-get install -y fonts-noto-cjk

sudo apt-get install -y meson ninja-build build-essential pkg-config libglib2.0-dev libnghttp2-dev libsqlite3-dev libpsl-dev libbrotli-dev glib-networking
meson setup .e2e/libsoup-build .e2e/libsoup-source --prefix="$RUNNER_TEMP/webkit-soup" --libdir=lib --wrap-mode=nofallback -Dgssapi=disabled -Dvapi=disabled -Dntlm=disabled -Dsysprof=disabled -Dautobahn=disabled -Dpkcs11_tests=disabled -Dintrospection=disabled -Ddocs=disabled -Dtests=false
meson compile -C .e2e/libsoup-build
meson install -C .e2e/libsoup-build
echo "QA_SOUP_LIBRARY=$RUNNER_TEMP/webkit-soup/lib/libsoup-3.0.so.0" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
